duration.text: The Environmental Sciences at Ocean University of China is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4305 USD/per year ￥ 31000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here. 7. Study Plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. Be in good health 2. College graduate with a Master's degree 3. Pass the entrance examination hold by Ocean University of China
